name: Foundation, Tooling, Tokens & Infrastructure
description: Repository scaffolding, pnpm configuration, strict TypeScript/ESLint/Prettier, Tailwind theme and tokens, Supabase client, Auth and Query providers, routing core, and CI/CD pipelines.

name: Database Schema, Tables, Indexes & RLS Policies
description: PostgreSQL schemas, identity and school tables, curriculum and content structures, assessment tables, gamification ledgers, AI system tables, security RLS policies, and core database indexes.

name: Database RPC Business Logic, Economy & Triggers
description: PostgreSQL stored procedures (RPCs), economy reward engine, streak calculators, quiz/assignment scoring functions, enrollment logic, shop purchases, and automated database triggers.

name: Supabase Edge Functions, AI Streaming & Jobs
description: Deno Edge Functions for AI chat streaming, safety pipelines, text-to-speech audio synthesis, async background job runners, CSV bulk imports, asset uploads, and Realtime event hubs.

name: Shared UI Kit, Arcade Primitives & Shells
description: Accessible, keyboard-friendly UI primitives following GLOBAL-STYLES (2px black outlines, solid offset shadows, Fredoka/Figtree fonts, world colors), form controls, overlays, navigation shells, and feedback components.

name: Shared Public Pages & Authentication
description: Public landing page with arcade animations, sign-in flows, password reset, inactive account handling, school contact, FAQ, terms, and system status/error pages (SH-01 to SH-14).

name: Student Core Learning, Courses & Assessments
description: Student portal core pages: dashboard, course list, unit map, interactive lesson player, activity screens, quiz attempt runner, assignment submission, results, and account settings (ST-01 to ST-14, ST-31).

name: Student Gamification, Quests, Shop, Games & AI Tutor
description: Gamified learning features: AI Tutor conversational chat, 7 arcade minigames, daily quests, weekly challenges, class leaderboards, achievements, rewards shop, and in-app notifications (ST-20 to ST-27, ST-30).

name: Teacher Dashboard, Classes, Grading & Work
description: Teacher portal core pages: dashboard, class manager, roster and enrollment, class rules and rewards, student profiles, homework/quiz management, grading queue, interactive grading screen, and reports (TC-01 to TC-08, TC-13 to TC-16, TC-20 to TC-29).

name: Teacher Builders, Question Bank, Rubrics & AI Wizards
description: Curriculum and assessment authoring tools: course builder, lesson block editor, quiz builder, assignment authoring, question bank, rubric designer, AI Course Wizard, AI Planner, and AI Support Plans (TC-09 to TC-12, TC-14, TC-17, TC-19, TC-30 to TC-32).

name: Admin Control Room, Operations, Governance & Settings
description: School administrator control room: user management, CSV import, academic year rollover, curriculum governance, moderation queue, economy studios, AI governance & limits, audit log, and platform settings (AD-01 to AD-29).
